channel.title: The Grant Desk - Writers, EU, next 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Writers, EU, next 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 24 Aug 2026 (24 Aug to 30 Aug 2026).

  • Sphera Media Lab 2026: Open Call for Masterclasses and Keynotes
    European Lab (Arty Farty) and the Sphera Network, coordinated by Medianes · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Selected contributors receive a fee plus travel to Brussels and accommodation, all covered by the organisers. The fee amount is not published in the call. No...
  • Fonds BJP: Dossiersubsidie for Freelance Regional and Local Journalists (autumn 2026 round)
    Fonds Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten (Fonds BJP) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 19,200 for six months of work on a single reporting dossier. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new grants - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
5 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 20 Jul 2026 (20 Jul to 26 Jul 2026).

  • Comic Creation Grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000. No application fee.
  • Emerging Authors: Frankfurter Seilschaften
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Hotel and travel expenses, per diems, and trade fair passes (amounts not specified). No application fee.
  • Literary Creation Grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 25,000 (writing), CHF 18,000 (theatre texts), or CHF 15,000 (performative literary projects). No application fee.
  • Writing in Residency
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Travel and accommodation costs (vary by destination); childcare support up to CHF 1,000 per month for applicants with caregiving responsibilities. No applica...
  • International Promotion: Institutions in Switzerland (Literature)
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000. No application fee.
